about_the_game:
You are a ghost in a world forgotten by time.

Save your soul is a brutal 2D precision platformer where you control a ghost wandering the corridors of a forgotten world. This place is not just emptiness. It is a darkness where every move you make could be your last. Traps and the eternal struggle with impossible obstacles are your reality.

You wake up as a restless spirit, having lost your form and purpose. You are neither alive nor dead – you simply exist in a world that ignores you, doesn't notice you, but is ready to consume you. A world where every corner hides a deadly danger.

⚙️ Gameplay

Precision is everything: every trajectory, every movement requires perfection. You cannot afford a single mistake, or you'll have to start over.

Dangers: spikes, mechanisms – traps at every corner, ready to devour you into this endless hell.

Brutal difficulty: the game does not forgive mistakes. You control a ghost that exists in a world built on suffering.

The world as a maze: every level is not just a place. It’s an enclosed space where every corner can be both a shelter and a trap.

☠️ Death as part of the Journey

You are a ghost. You cannot die, but you can be consumed by the darkness and oblivion. Every mistake is a fall into an endless black void. You will die and return again, trying to overcome unbearable obstacles and break this chain of fear and pain.

You are not alive.

You are not dead.

You are a ghost, doomed to wander a dark world full of traps and oblivion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A dark 2D precision platformer. Every move is a risk. Every level is torture. Survive in a dying world where mistakes mean death and mastery is the only way out. Control a ghost lost among traps and silence in a world that no longer waits for anyone.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Japanese
